name: Titanium-Case Rounded-Square Smartwatch
description: A minimalist rounded-square smartwatch with a matte titanium-grey aluminum case, a sapphire-coated black display glass, a woven stone-grey nylon strap, and a polished stainless-steel side crown.
materials: matte titanium-grey aluminum case, sapphire-coated black display glass, woven stone-grey nylon strap, polished stainless-steel side crown
primaryColors: titanium grey, stone-grey nylon, black display glass
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the case, case back, crown, or strap; never render a second crown or button, or a visible pixel grid on the display glass; never swap the nylon strap for a metal bracelet or leather band
preservationNotes: the matte titanium case finish, stone-grey nylon strap weave, single side crown, sapphire display glass, and completely plain unmarked case back must read identically in every angle, same case proportions and crown position throughout
